title: One dependable connection opens the roster
summary: Open the authorised roster from one protected database snapshot instead of several consecutive requests.
changes: The account check, staffing, allocations and essential settings now arrive in one protected database response.
The connection recovery actions wait long enough for a normal slow response before appearing.
The saved-roster fallback remains read-only if the single shared request genuinely fails.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy or database rules.
